description.value:
Trigger You Break the Anchor against a Named target that bears a bio-augment.

Break the Anchor can target a Named creature's bio-augment instead of the creature itself, disabling it.

You may direct Break the Anchor's effect at one bio-augment the target bears instead of at the target's Anchor. On a success, the augment is disabled — nonfunctional until repaired with an hour's work — instead of applying Break the Anchor's usual effect. This can't target an augment Cultured-sourced and installed in a willing patient's own flesh below Straining Load; those grafts have gone too fully theirs for a Ward to get a grip on.

cinderfall.incomplete: This affects another creature's own roll, HP, item, or condition from the card holder's self-held passive/item, which has no rule-element hook in real pf2e. Specifically: redirecting a self-held reaction's effect to disable a specific bio-augment the target creature possesses, chosen by the wardbreaker's own trigger condition -- no selector exists in pf2e for disabling/altering an item a different creature is wearing or carrying from a self-held ability.
